text:
Which statement about the direction of a magnetic field at a point is correct?
A
It is the direction of the force on an N pole placed at that point.
B
It is the direction of the force on an S pole placed at that point.
C
It is the direction of the force on a positive charge placed at that point.
D
It is the direction of the force on a negative charge placed at that point.

options.label: A
options.text: It is the direction of the force on an N pole placed at that point.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the direction of the force on an S pole placed at that point.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the direction of the force on a positive charge placed at that point.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the direction of the force on a negative charge placed at that point.
